scope:
New scenario: discrete local voltage-control taps, using source control bands.

Not source reconstruction and not a claim of operator-authorised tap changes.
Only explicit two-winding COD=+1, nonzero downstream CONT, no compensation,
no impedance-correction table, and valid discrete bounds are eligible.
